scope: Authored 561 Group prose, excluding quotations, citations, code, vendor identifiers, original titles and archival evidence

foreignSenseRule.prohibitedAction: Never infer a monetary WIT/ACK/ATT from a constructive proof witness, legal testimonial witness, transformer attention head, cognitive-science attention, marketing impressions, or a historical source quotation.

receipt.fileContentSha256: Exact UTF-8 bytes of the whole source, as SHA-256 lowercase hex
receipt.profileContentSha256: Exact UTF-8 bytes of the source-owned Science JSON profile, as SHA-256 lowercase hex
receipt.sourceVersion: Nonempty reviewed document path/revision; an anonymous location may be scanned but cannot be review-receipted
receipt.sourceSpan: UTF-16 half-open [start,end] of the exact candidate text
receipt.sort: One of that term's admissibleSorts[].id, or foreign-discipline
receipt.details: Object containing all required fields for that sort
receipt.sourceRef: Non-empty URI of the canonical or independent distinct-discipline authority
receipt.reviewedBy: Non-empty human or authorized office identity; a parser alone cannot admit meaning

invariants: A scanner reports candidate spans, not mathematical facts.
Receipts are invalidated by any change to the exact source SHA-256 or occurrence offsets.
A review receipt requires this exact Science policy source SHA-256 and its reviewed document identity; an unchanged excerpt under another policy or path is not pre-approved.
The Engineering reviewer must hash the same exact UTF-8 profile bytes it parses; a caller-supplied policy hash or anonymous document identity alone never qualifies a receipt.
A collision form is a review trigger, never a synonym or permission to replace a canonical term.
Validating receipt shape does not prove the cited sources or semantic judgment.
Canonical WIT refers to exactly one FOUR knowledge-order cover, not a whole encounter or an arbitrary Record increment.
ACK requires an actor other than the original assertion actor, not merely an author's declaration.
ATT distinguishes bounded budget allocation and second-order WIT of ACK; a balance is not identical to an individual move.
Evidence Record tallies and economic paired settlement tallies must remain distinct.
